from pathlib import Path
root = Path('.')
new_run = root/'out/ingestion/workbench/run-397f4c7683d24d44ae43537e5ad8dd28'
old_run = root/'out/ingestion/workbench/run-05888c57424f4db48bd9821fc8324b36'

old_receipt = json.loads((old_run/'receipt.json').read_text())

outputs_equal = new_receipt.get('outputs') == old_receipt.get('outputs')

    'scene_sections_equal': section_equal,

    'old_scene_review': old_scene.get('ingestion',{}).get('cursor_review'),

    'render_inputs_equal': render_inputs_equal,
    'outputs_equal': outputs_equal,
    'new_outputs_count': len(new_receipt.get('outputs', {})),
    'old_outputs_count': len(old_receipt.get('outputs', {})),
}
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))

new_scene=json.loads((Path('out/ingestion/workbench/run-397f4c7683d24d44ae43537e5ad8dd28/scene.json')).read_text())

print(json.dumps({'dataset_count':len(new_datasets),'per_dataset':pairs,'all_qualification_equal':all(p['qualification_data_equal'] for p in pairs)}, indent=2))
